findings.finding: Returned next_value_start values are checked for integer type, nonnegativity, and repeats, but not for strict forward progress. A sequence such as 9 -> 4 -> 13 is accepted and the corresponding string pieces are concatenated in request order, which can duplicate/overlap decoded text and produce an inexact projected scalar.
findings.impact: The projection can emit a reconstructed consumed value from a malformed/non-forward continuation sequence despite the exact-value and fail-closed invariant.
findings.fix: Require every returned next_value_start to be strictly greater than the value_start used for that response; add a synthetic backward-but-nonrepeating continuation refusal case.
